bullets.text: In Thiruvallur and Chennai, high sea waves and entering rainwater distress residents in Bharathiyar Nagar, requiring continuous office monitoring of relief measures.
Along the ECR coastal stretch from Tiruvanmiyur to Uthandi, authorities use loudspeakers to warn the public against visiting the turbulent sea.
Passengers fear a Chennai Airport shutdown as planned stormwater drain work drags on, so the office should watch drainage progress closely.
PMK MLA Sowmya Anbumani urged the Tamil Nadu government to issue an immediate notification legally recognizing the Pallikaranai marshland.
People demanded the arrest of culprits who damaged ancient temple idols, including the Nandi statue at the Somanathar temple.
Following Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay's inspection, concerns regarding the management and rainwater storage of the Chembarambakkam reservoir have come into focus.
Tata Communications plans to invest up to $450 million to build a 10,000-kilometer India AI Super Highway connectivity network.
Researchers from IIIT-H and Ati Robotics demonstrated AI vision-based robot navigation that ditches LiDAR by using visual cues.
MP Kanimozhi accused the TVK government of failing to keep Aavin product prices under control.
